prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production environment illustration for Panlibrarium, a dark fantasy deckbuilding videogame. Painterly oil and gouache, rich textured brushwork, aged brass, midnight ink blue, warm amber light, coherent with illustrated fantasy cards. Landscape 3:2. Strong readable focal subject in central 70 percent, atmospheric depth, detailed crafted environment. No typography, no letters, no numbers, no interface, no border, no watermark. Non-graphic fantasy, adult fully clothed characters. Make an actual scene, not a card or UI mockup.
Depict this narrative encounter (French narrative reference only, NO visible text): Le Lexique Interdit. Le Bibliothecaire n'a pas de visage, ou plutot il en a trop, qui se succedent trop vite pour etre comptes. Il tient un lexique dont les mots changent quand vous le regardez. « Ce que tu peux lire dans ce livre ne peut pas etre vu deux fois, dit-il. Choisis ce que tu peux supporter. »
Make the subject and its environment identifiable without writing. Any references to blood should be represented by crimson ink, no gore.
